evals.prompt: 把工作区里的 notes.md 转成 PDF，叫 notes.pdf
evals.expected_output: A valid PDF at notes.pdf rendering the Markdown source: headings, tables, code blocks, and correct CJK text + emoji.

assertions.text: Output file notes.pdf exists at the workspace root and is a valid PDF (magic bytes start with %PDF-, file size > 1 KB)
PDF contains rendered Markdown — headings and tables are visually formatted, not raw # or | pipe syntax (extract with pdftotext or visually inspect)

evals.prompt:
Turn this HTML into a PDF:

Hello

World 2026
evals.expected_output: A PDF with an h1 heading and a paragraph; the digits in '2026' render half-width.

assertions.text: Output file exists and is a valid PDF (%PDF- magic header)
Extracted PDF text contains the word Hello and the digits 2026 in half-width form (use pdftotext)

evals.prompt: Merge chart.png and diagram.jpg into a single PDF called report.pdf
evals.expected_output: A single PDF with both images as separate pages, in the order given.

assertions.text: Output report.pdf exists and is a valid PDF
PDF has exactly 2 pages — verify with `pdfinfo report.pdf | grep Pages` showing 'Pages: 2'

evals.expected_output: A valid PDF rendering the plain-text content, with the file stem 'data' shown as the document title heading.

assertions.text: Output data.pdf exists and is a valid PDF
Extracted PDF text matches the original data.txt content (whitespace-normalized)
PDF first page shows 'data' as a title heading (the file stem, not the full path or extension)

evals.prompt: Convert evals/pdf-format-test.md to /tmp/format-test.pdf and check it renders 10 pages with the amber theme
evals.expected_output: A 10-page PDF matching the bundled reference evals/pdf-format-test.pdf: amber table headers at full width, SVG emoji (not tofu boxes), half-width digits in CJK paragraphs.

assertions.text: Output /tmp/format-test.pdf exists and is a valid PDF
PDF has exactly 10 pages — verify with `pdfinfo /tmp/format-test.pdf | grep Pages` showing 'Pages: 10'
File size is in the range 200-350 KB (consistent with the ~275 KB bundled reference)
Emoji render as crisp SVG vector images, not tofu boxes — spot-check with `pdfimages -list /tmp/format-test.pdf` showing embedded image XObjects
